root_cause.text: The work item dump_work is not canceled or synchronized with the deallocation of crash_data in the device removal path, causing a use-after-free when the work executes after the data is freed.
root_cause.evidence: The race condition shown in the CVE description: CPU 0 frees crash_data via vfree() in mt7996_coredump_unregister(), while CPU 1 concurrently runs mt7996_mac_dump_work() which dereferences crash_data. The patch adds cancel_work_sync(&dev->dump_work) in mt7996_unregister_device() before the crash_data is freed to prevent this.
